acceptance_gate: No placement oracle, solvable matched recurrence breaks at all three depths, complete cached primitive and equally informed inline comparators, and per-phase and failed-trial costs.
completion_gate: Check each returned executable on every assignment, report search scaling and verdict on whether to open the preselected discovery phase.
objective: On fresh paired tasks at three composition depths compare the supplied learned binary-operation composition with cached primitive search and an inlined library. Discover a library on separate tasks only if the supplied one shows a growing advantage.
status: On eight four-application recurring rules a direct joint test needed 716 trials against 810 with primitives; five of eight improved. Factor-first and fixed-nine trial savings failed. All 2,160 returned programs passed independent replay. The bounded discovery phase qualified.
stop_rule: After exhaustive correctness and accounting across the fixed panel, execute a fresh discovery-and-transfer experiment only for an appreciable growing advantage over cached primitives as specified in preregistration. A gain shared with the inline control qualifies. Otherwise stop after reporting the bottleneck.
title: Does repeatedly using an unlocated fold avoid more program search at greater depth?
